svg.text: Actual 2L b018 - South7 manual routing map (same TOP-view XY on both panels; BOTTOM is NOT mirrored)
Source SHA D229F4A52025454CC81A627DA4BA7E3BB9E7A222235C33A3DC090F901B8CEF96; 7 GPIO joins pending; whole-board DRC pending. No proposed copper is drawn.
TOP copper / native pads and drills / 5mm coordinates
BOTTOM copper / native pads and drills / 5mm coordinates
Green faint = actual GND fill; colored solid = actual manual trace/pad copper; circles = true drill/pad sizes; dashed gray = native PlaceBound context.
Purple dashed = actual deliberate HSE void; mustard dashed = USB engineering reference-protection overlay (not copper); orange J12 ghost is a comparison only.
Regular non-circular pads shown from native transformed copper bbox. Signal-only view; mask apertures/assembly clearance and board manufacturing remain separate checks.
